notes: v0.3.0 release-tree measurement. hello/hash/busy were re-measured on master @ a884a158 with validate.sh --full --require-metal (PASS 34/0/0; 1 warm-up + 8 serial runs/lane; receipt verified + journal asserted each run; CPU lane via R0_DISABLE_METAL=1) — bundle evidence/20260616T133558Z (top-level pointer). Speedups 1.638/1.748/1.739x for hello/hash/busy are within run-to-run variance of the v0.2.0/Phase-0 figures (1.70/1.63/1.70x and 1.571/1.734/1.766x); the structural story (eval_check CPU floor bounds the speedup) is unchanged. The multiseg/mempress/shaheavy/ecdsa adopter rows are unchanged from the Phase 2 bundle evidence/adopter-20260615T102417Z (summary.json sha256 ec7ff1f8ab3759a36e123afedfdaed8552050d9092c35cd976382c9faec87f08), 1 warm-up + 5 serial runs/lane, all clustering at 1.722x-1.732x with a measured ~87% (eval_check ~83%) circuit floor. Each workload's exact files are pinned in its own per-workload evidence block; the speedup holds across single-segment, multi-segment, real-dependency sha2/k256, memory-pressure, and ECDSA-verify workloads and does not erode toward 1x at these sizes.
